title: Cave Point E-Bike Ride + Scotty's Pub + Grub Dinner
why: Fall visitors who want an easy afternoon: short e-bike ride to Cave Point, then burgers, chicken or pizza on Hwy 57 in Jacksonport.
hook_options: Ride Cave Point. Burgers are on Hwy 57.
Earn your broasted chicken on an e-bike.
Cliffs first, pizza and wings after.
caption: Easy fall afternoon: grab a fat tire e-bike at our Jacksonport shop, ride about 4.5 miles to Cave Point, then roll back for burgers, broasted chicken or pizza at Scotty's Pub + Grub, one minute from our shop. Two hours on the bike is plenty. Food photos courtesy of Scotty's. Save this for your trip and send it to your dinner crew. #DoorCounty #Jacksonport #CavePoint #EBikeRental #DoorCountyFall

slides.headline: Earn the burger. Ride Cave Point.
slides.body: Scotty's Pub + Grub is one minute from our Jacksonport shop.

slides.headline: Rent the bike.
slides.body: Fat tire e-bikes, ready at our Jacksonport shop. Book online at doorcountykayaktours.com.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave Point Ebike Rental.jpg

slides.headline: Start on Hwy 57.
slides.body: Fat tire e-bikes are $30 an hour or $60 for two. Two hours covers the ride and a good look around.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-point-county-park-electric-bike-rental.jpg

slides.headline: Ride to Cave Point.
slides.body: About 4.5 miles from the shop. Cliffs, clear water and picnic tables if you want a stop.

slides.headline: Mind the edge.
slides.body: Rocks are slippery when wet, and the water is shallow. No jumping.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-Point-County-Park-Bike-Rental.jpg

slides.headline: Ride back to Jacksonport.
slides.body: Hwy 57 is a state highway, so ride single file. Bring the bike back to the shop.

slides.headline: Scotty's Pub + Grub.
slides.body: Burgers, broasted chicken, pizza and wings. Fish fry on Fridays.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Scottys Pub Grub (permission OK 2026-10-26)/scottys-burger-fb.jpg

slides.headline: Happy hour.
slides.body: Scotty's runs $2 off cocktails and $1 off beer, 2 to 4 pm on Mondays and Tuesdays.

slides.headline: Cave Point ride. Scotty's dinner.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Scottys Pub Grub (permission OK 2026-10-26)/scottys-sign-owners-fb.jpg
